name: CTI Source Collection
description: Collects recent metadata from reviewed CTI RSS sources without using AI or Telegram.

parameters.query: SELECT id AS source_id, name AS source_name, feed_url, allowed_hosts FROM cti.sources WHERE enabled = true ORDER BY trust_score DESC, id;
SELECT source.id AS source_id, source.name AS source_name, source.feed_url, source.allowed_hosts FROM cti.sources AS source WHERE source.id = $1 AND source.enabled = true;
SELECT article_id, is_new, occurrence_added FROM cti.ingest_feed_item($1, $2, $3, $4, $5::timestamptz);

INSERT INTO cti.workflow_log (workflow_name, level, event_code, details) VALUES ('CTI Source Collection', 'warning', 'feed_item_rejected', jsonb_build_object('source_id', $1::bigint, 'source_name', left($2::text, 200), 'reason', left($3::text, 100), 'hostname', nullif(left($4::text, 253), ''), 'url', left($5::text, 1000))) RETURNING id AS workflow_log_id;

WITH checked AS MATERIALIZED (SELECT cti.record_source_check($1, false, 'feed_read_failed')), logged AS (INSERT INTO cti.workflow_log (workflow_name, level, event_code, details) SELECT 'CTI Source Collection', 'error', 'feed_read_failed', jsonb_build_object('source_id', $1::bigint, 'source_name', left($2::text, 200)) FROM checked RETURNING id) SELECT id AS workflow_log_id FROM logged;

WITH checked AS MATERIALIZED (SELECT cti.record_source_check($1, false, 'feed_item_store_failed')), logged AS (INSERT INTO cti.workflow_log (workflow_name, level, event_code, details) SELECT 'CTI Source Collection', 'error', 'feed_item_store_failed', jsonb_build_object('source_id', $1::bigint, 'source_name', left($2::text, 200)) FROM checked RETURNING id) SELECT id AS workflow_log_id FROM logged;
